name: vrp-set-covering-master
description: Restricted master problem of the column-generation procedure for the Vehicle Routing Problem. A set-covering/set-partitioning LP selects a minimum-cost subset of feasible routes (columns) such that every customer node is visited. During column generation the route-selection variables are continuous (LP relaxation, 0<=y<=1); the final iteration is solved as a MIP with y binary. Implemented in PuLP via LpConstraintVar 'column' construction (each route variable carries its coefficients into the covering constraints and objective).

indices.name: V
indices.description: set of customer nodes that must be visited (graph nodes excluding Source, Sink and depot_from/depot_to markers)

indices.name: Omega
indices.description: set of feasible routes (columns); only a subset is present at any iteration of column generation

indices.name: Omega_v
indices.description: routes r in Omega that visit node v

indices.name: K
indices.description: set of vehicle types (heterogeneous fleet); index k

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: cost of route r (sum of edge costs along the route for its vehicle type) [domain R_>=0]

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: required visit frequency / RHS of covering constraint for node v (1 in the standard case, frequency in the periodic case) [domain Z_>=1]

parameters.name: U
parameters.description: upper bound on number of vehicles of type k [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: per-node drop penalty added to objective when node-dropping is allowed [domain R_>=0]

variables.name: lambda
variables.description: 1 if and only if route r is selected

variables.name: drop
variables.description: 1 if and only if node v is dropped (left unserved), only present when drop_penalty is set

variables.name: periodic
variables.description: artificial variable used only in the periodic case to find an initial feasible solution (huge 1e10 objective penalty)

variables.name: artificial_bound
variables.description: artificial variable relaxing the vehicle-count constraint for type k (huge 1e10 objective penalty), forced to 0 in the final MIP

variables.name: makespan
variables.description: global span (max route cost) auxiliary variable, only present when minimize_global_span is set

constraints.name: set_covering_visit_node
constraints.description: every customer node v must be covered by at least f_v selected routes (eq. 1). The constraint sense is >= during the LP relaxation and is switched to = (set-partitioning, exactly f_v) when the master is solved as a MIP. [capture: sum restriction not representable: 'v \\in r']

constraints.name: vehicle_count_bound
constraints.description: the number of selected routes of vehicle type k may not exceed the available vehicles U_k. Sense becomes = (use all vehicles) if use_all_vehicles is set; an artificial_bound_k variable relaxes it during pricing. [capture: sum restriction not representable: '\\mathrm{type}(r)=k']

constraints.name: makespan_definition
constraints.description: when minimizing the global span, an auxiliary makespan variable bounds the cost of every selected route from above and is minimized instead of the total cost.

objective.name: objective
objective.description: minimize the total cost of the selected routes (with optional additive drop penalties and big-1e10 artificial-variable penalties)
